profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
•	12 years of experience working in JAVA/J2EE technologies.
•	Strong Experience in object oriented language Java.
•	Experience working with Eclipse, My Eclipse, RAD- Designing, Coding and Packaging Java Applications.
•	Extensive experience in using Struts and Spring (MVC Architecture) Framework.
•	Worked extensively with front-end components using HTML, CSS, Java Script, Java Server Pages JSP, AJAX, Servlets, jQuery,JSON.
•	Extensive experience in design JSON requests according to the front end pages, also design JSON responses according the request, send it back to the front end after the logic processing.
•	Experience with Design/Architectural Patterns.
•	Extensive experience in using Magento builds Web-site.
•	Excellent Knowledge of determined the SEO strategy and tactics necessary to drive traffic to web sites.
•	Experience in generating UML (Unified Modeling Language) used case diagrams, class and sequence diagrams using Microsoft Visio and My Eclipse.
•	Worked experience in Web Services, XML, XSLT, XML-Schema, DTD, SAX, DOM.
•	Experience in working with Web and Application Servers like Apache Tomcat, IBM Websphere, BEA WebLogic, JBoss.
•	Experience of working with databases Oracle 9i/ 10g and SQL Server, MySQL with Relational Database Management System (RDBMS) Design, Normalization, and Database Management oriented concepts 
•	Experience in developing data models using Hibernate (Relationships, Hibernate DAO), Object relation mapping (ORM) framework. 
•	Understanding and Writing knowledge of UNIX Shell script programming.
•	Used Log4j for application logging and notification tracing mechanism.
•	Experience in Agile methodologies for system development.
•	Well acquainted with the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) for Development Projects.
•	Highly motivated, dedicated, fast learner and has proven my abilities in my projects.
•	Very much comfortable to work with sense of urgency in an aggressive, multi-tasking environment.

positions.title: VP  Lead Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Jersey City, New Jersey, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
•	Follow Agile methodologies.
•	Implementing the application using Spring Boot and ElasticSearch.
•	Build application using Java EE components using Spring ecosystem Framework.
•	Implementing filters for user authentication and user authorization by Spring Auth Security.
•	Using Java 11 features in developing the code like Lambda expressions, creating resource classes, fetching documents from Elastic Search JSON.
•	Developing test cases with jUnit, MOCKITO, POWERMOCK for Unit testing.
Technical Environment 
JDK 11, J2EE, Spring Core, Spring boot, Spring Auth2, Spring MVC,Elastic Search template, Elastic Search, Kibana,Kafka streaming, Apache tomcat, Maven, jUnit, Mokito and Powermock library, IntelliJ IDE, JIRA, Git, Bibucket, Jenkins,Sonar Qube
positions.insights: Skills: Elasticsearch · Core Spring, Spring MVC, Spring boot · Java · Java Enterprise Edition

positions.title: Project Lead
positions.description:
•	Designed application components in an Agile environment utilizing a test driven development approach.
•	Delivered Jersey REST APIs written in Java 8 and ElasticSearch as the core Search platform.
•	Extensively used core java concepts like Multithreading, Collections Framework, File I/o and concurrency.
•	Use Java8 features in developing the code like Lambda expressions, creating resource classes, fetching documents from ES JSON. 
•	Developing test cases with jUnit, MOCKITO, POWERMOCK for Unit testing, and logging using Log4j.
•	Continuous integration using Jenkins, JIRA, GIT and BitBucket.
Technical Environment 
JDK 1.8, J2EE, Jersey REST API, Spring Core, Spring boot, Spring Auth2, Elastic Search 6+, Kibana, Kafka streaming,AngularJS, Angular2+, Apache tomcat, Maven, jUnit, Mokito and Powermock library, IntelliJ IDE, JIRA, Git, Bibucket,Jenkins, Sonar Qube,Linux,IAM Authentication and Authorization Principles,Microservices,

positions.title: Full Stack Java Developer
positions.description:
•	Participating in designing and development of software using agile development by executing Sprint development lifecycle.
•	Code and develop Java base ES queries and custom ES query aggregations using the Jersey REST API for searching and accessing data in Elastic search.
•	Core java development for different components. Developed the application using Core Java 8 programming, Multi-Threading, Spring Core and Beans.
•	Application deployment on Tomcat and as standalone Java processes.
•	Write jUnit test case using mockito library.
•	Design Jersey Restful Web APIs, including JSON data formats and API versioning strategy.
•	Used IntelliJ IDE for develop and integrate Java code.
•	UI side using Angular2,AngularJS, HTML, CSS, and bootstrap javascript.   
•	Used JIRA for bug tracking, issue tracking and project management.
•	Used Git and Bitbucket shared versioning service and file repository.

Technical Environment	
JDK 1.8, J2EE, Jersey REST API,  Spring Core, Elastic Search, Kibana, Kafka streaming,Angular2, AngularJS, Apache tomcat, Maven, jUnit, Mokito library, IntelliJ IDE, JIRA, Git, Bibucket

positions.description:
